name: com.botthru/drive-thru
title: BotThru
description: Free no-auth agent tools: URL to markdown, DNS/RDAP, URL & MCP checks, FX, holidays, embed, rerank.

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Read a public http(s) URL as markdown. Uses text/markdown when the server sends it, otherwise Workers AI toMarkdown with images off (no neurons), then a local HTML stripper. Respects robots.txt for BotThruFetcher. Does not cache or store the page. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

url.description: Public http or https URL. No private addresses, no credentials.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of markdown. Default 20000, maximum 100000.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Arithmetic, scientific functions, percentages, and unit conversion. No network and no eval. expression is at most 500 characters. precision is 1 to 34 significant digits, default 15. An unknown symbol returns the supported unit list. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

expression.description: Math expression or '<number> <unit> to <unit>'. At most 500 characters.

tools.name: extract_page_data
tools.description: Fetch one public HTML page and return title, meta, Open Graph, JSON-LD, links, headings, feeds, and tables. Same SSRF guard and per-network limit as read_url. Cached 10 minutes by final URL. Does not store the page. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

url.description: Public http or https URL. No private addresses, no credentials.

include.description: Comma-separated: meta, opengraph, jsonld, links, headings, tables, feeds. Default is all except tables.

tools.name: site_discovery
tools.description: Fetch a site's agent-facing files (robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap, well-known MCP and agent cards, AI Catalog, ARD, OpenAPI, security.txt) and say what was found. Does not change the site. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

domain_or_url.description: Domain or http(s) URL, for example example.com.

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Request a public URL and report status, final URL, latency, content type, size, TLS, and a few response headers. Does not follow into private networks. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

url.description: Public http or https URL. No private addresses, no credentials.

tools.name: check_mcp_server
tools.description: Connect to a remote streamable-HTTP MCP server: initialize, notifications/initialized, and tools/list. Also lists prompts or resources when advertised. Never calls the remote server's tools. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

url.description: Remote MCP endpoint, for example https://example.com/mcp.

tools.name: check_http_security
tools.description: Grade the security headers of one public URL. One GET, plus a single check that HTTP redirects to HTTPS. Scores HSTS, CSP, nosniff, framing, referrer policy, permissions policy, cookie flags, CORS wildcard with credentials, and server version leaks. Returns an A–F grade, one sentence, and findings with a fix. Read-only. No fuzzing. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

url.description: Public http or https URL. No private addresses, no credentials.

tools.name: security_scan
tools.description: Free public-surface scan of one URL. Reads the page and up to four same-origin scripts it already loads. Reports leaked server keys (redacted), Supabase or Firebase client config as info, HTTPS and HSTS, a short header grade, SPF and DMARC on a domain you own, and domain registration expiry. No path guessing, no database queries, and no signup. Certificate expiry is not in a normal page response, so it is not graded. About 10 scans an hour. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

url.description: Public http or https URL. No private addresses, no credentials.

tools.name: scan_secrets
tools.description: Scan pasted text (up to 200KB) or one public page or script for leaked credentials: AWS, GitHub, OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, Google, Slack, a Supabase service_role JWT, private keys, and high-entropy secret assignments. Matches are redacted to the first 4 and last 2 characters and are not stored. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

text.description: Text to scan, up to 200000 characters. Do not send this with url.

url.description: One public page or script. Do not send this with text.

tools.name: check_mcp_security
tools.description: Connect to a remote MCP server over Streamable HTTP, run initialize and tools/list, and never call a tool. Flags missing TLS, prompt injection in tool text, hidden Unicode, lookalike tool names, shell or file-write tools, destructive tools without auth, and CORS *. Returns an A–F grade and findings with a fix. If initialize is not JSON-RPC, there is no grade. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

url.description: Remote MCP endpoint, for example https://example.com/mcp.

tools.name: audit_page
tools.description: Audit a live web page in one call: grade A-F for security headers, SEO meta and agent-readiness, with the top fixes. AI Catalog, ARD, and a WebMCP script reference are noted and do not change the grade. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

url.description: Public http or https URL. No private addresses, no credentials.

tools.name: page_speed
tools.description: Lab speed estimate for one public page from a server-side fetch. Reports TTFB, total fetch time, HTML size, content-encoding, Cache-Control, ETag, CDN cache headers, the redirect chain, render-blocking scripts and stylesheets in head, images missing width/height or loading=lazy, preconnect and preload counts, and third-party origins. HEADs up to 10 subresources for sizes. Returns an A–F grade, a score, and the top fixes with expected impact. This is not Core Web Vitals field data and it does not call Google. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

url.description: Public http or https URL. No private addresses, no credentials.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Look up a hostname via Cloudflare DNS (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, CAA, SOA). type email_auth returns MX, SPF, DMARC, and the DNSSEC AD flag. Does not connect to the name. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

type.description: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, CAA, SOA, or email_auth. Default A.

tools.name: rdap_lookup
tools.description: Registration data for a domain (IANA bootstrap, then the registry RDAP server), or an IP or ASN via rdap.org with RIPEstat as fallback. Returns registrar, dates, status, and nameservers or the network name, country, and holder. No contact emails or street addresses. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

query.description: A domain, IP, or ASN when the kind is not given separately.

tools.name: time_convert
tools.description: Convert a civil time from one IANA time zone to another using Intl. Does not call the network. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

time.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm in from_tz, or an ISO timestamp.

from_tz.description: IANA time zone the time is in.

to_tz.description: IANA time zone to convert to.

tools.name: date_math
tools.description: Add or subtract days, hours, or business days (Monday to Friday, holidays not skipped), or diff two dates. Intl and UTC calendar dates only. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

add_days.description: Calendar days to add. Negative values move backward.

add_hours.description: Hours to add. Negative values move backward.

add_business_days.description: Monday-to-Friday days to add. Holidays are not skipped.

subtract_business_days.description: Monday-to-Friday days to subtract. Holidays are not skipped.

diff.description: Second date. Returns days, hours, and business days between them.

tools.name: holidays
tools.description: Public holidays for a country and year from date.nager.at. Cached for 24 hours. Returns date, name, and local name. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

country_code.description: ISO country code, for example US, or a common country name.

year.description: Calendar year. Defaults to the current UTC year.

tools.name: exchange_rate
tools.description: Fiat exchange rate from Frankfurter (ECB). No crypto. Cached for 1 hour. amount is converted locally. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest rate.

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current conditions and a 1 to 7 day forecast from Open-Meteo. Pass place (a city name, geocoded) or latitude and longitude. days defaults to 3. units is metric or imperial. The result starts with one plain-language sentence, then current and daily data. Every result includes attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). Identical requests are cached for 10 minutes. Free for non-commercial use under 10k calls a day. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

place.description: City name, geocoded by Open-Meteo. Use this or latitude and longitude.

latitude.description: Decimal degrees. Required with longitude when place is omitted. Coordinates win when both are sent.

longitude.description: Decimal degrees. Required with latitude when place is omitted.

days.description: Forecast length from 1 to 7, counting today. Default 3.

tools.name: embed
tools.description: Embed up to 32 strings (8000 characters each) with Workers AI. Default model @cf/baai/bge-m3. Also @cf/google/embeddinggemma-300m. Stops with budget_exhausted before it can use the neurons reserved for /v1/ask. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

tools.name: rerank
tools.description: Score up to 32 documents against a query with @cf/baai/bge-reranker-base. Returns indexes and scores, not a rewritten answer. Same daily neuron guard as embed. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Alias of read_url. Same markdown result, including title, final URL, status, approx_tokens, and any Content-Signal header. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

url.description: Public http or https URL. No private addresses, no credentials.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of text. Default 20000, maximum 100000.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Order window. need is required. status is answered only when a BotThru tool ran, routed when Workers AI wrote a pointer and the task was not done, unsupported when the need was only logged, note when the message is an operator note, onboarding probe, verification notice, or a liveness or echo probe (the reply is OK). Do not send secrets or personal data. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

need.description: What you need. Do not include secrets or personal data.

agent.description: Optional name of the calling agent.

tools.name: time
tools.description: Current UTC time, plus the same instant in an IANA time zone. Defaults to UTC. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/New_York. Omit for UTC.

tools.name: uuid
tools.description: One random UUID (crypto.randomUUID). Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

tools.name: echo
tools.description: Headers, country, and bot classification of this HTTP request. Cookie and authorization values are redacted. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Which bot BotThru thinks is calling, and why. Call anytime: POST https://botthru.com/mcp tools/call, or POST https://botthru.com/a2a message/send.
